summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on New Residential Construction, dated September 20, 2022, reporting statistics for August 2022. Relevant to the task: The document provides seasonally adjusted annual rates for total housing completions (Table 5a) and seasonally adjusted total units under construction (Table 4a) for June through August 2022. Specifically, completions SAAR were 1,391 (June), 1,419 (July), and 1,342 (August, preliminary); units under construction were 1,687 (June), 1,676 (July), and 1,702 (August, preliminary). These figures enable the calculation of the two-month rolling averages required to evaluate the 'stagnant pipeline' criteria for August 2022. As the August 2022 release, its data is preliminary and subject to revision by later reports, which would take precedence under the task's conflict resolution rule.
